pages.observed: Five phone frames 0.0 s to 0.8 s of option a. Daylight airport curb scene under a canopy. A white SUV with a roof sensor dome slides in from the left, front wheel near the bay by 0.8 s. A phone card top left shows a route map with Ride requested. Caption from 0.2 s reads Anyone in San Antonio can now hail a Waymo with no driver, comma ending. No caption at frame 0.

Option a, 1.0 s to 1.8 s. The white SUV sits over the painted pickup bay at the curb with a red brake glow at its rear. Car position barely shifts across the five frames. Phone card top left still reads Ride requested, Finding a car. Caption unchanged, sits just below the car.

Option a, 2.0 s to 2.8 s. Car stays parked at the bay with rear brake glow while a small Texas outline card appears top right at 2.2 s. At 2.6 s the film cuts inside the cab: steering wheel at left, dashboard map screen at center, two empty gray front seats, airplane sign beyond the windshield. Phone card and caption remain. Caption overlaps the top of the seats.

Option a, 3.0 s to 3.8 s interior. The steering wheel turns by itself: its tan grip marker moves from the top to the right side. No hands, seats empty. Outside the windshield the airplane sign slides right and exits, implying the car moves. The Texas locator outline completes. Caption band covers the seat backs.

Option a, 4.0 s to 4.8 s. Interior cab view holds unchanged across all five frames: wheel marker parked at the right, empty seats, pale windshield with only the airplane sign edge at right. Texas locator outline complete. No visible motion between frames in this interval.

Option a, 5.0 s to 5.8 s. Interior holds through 5.2 s with the caption cleared at 5.2 s. At 5.4 s a closer curb shot: a large tilted phone with a route map fills the left half, the white car sits at the bay behind it at right. Phone label still reads Ride requested, Finding a car through 5.8 s. Caption the airport included. Locator card rings a point in south-central Texas.

Option a, 6.0 s to 6.8 s. On the large phone the car marker slides along the blue route to the destination pin and the status flips from Ride requested to Arriving, At the curb at 6.2 s. The white car stays parked behind the phone at the bay. Caption the airport included. clears by 6.6 s. Locator card keeps a ring in south-central Texas.

Option a, 7.0 s to 7.8 s. Cut to a pale paper map lying on a wooden table, with a February calendar page standing at its top right edge. The map holds a faint grid, a few green patches and three small pins; it stays nearly unchanged until 7.8 s when blue and orange line segments begin to draw on it. Caption The service began in February from 7.2 s, placed over the table below the map.

Option a, 8.0 s to 8.8 s. The street map draws in: a blue river line runs north to south and orange highway strokes plus an orange loop ring complete around the center pins. The February page stands unchanged at the map's top right. Locator card fades out. Caption The service began in February below the map.

Option a, 9.0 s to 9.8 s. Wide map holds to 9.2 s, then a closer view at 9.4 s with the February calendar page now tilted on the map surface. Through 9.8 s the page slides toward the center and covers part of the map and pins, while a thin black outline line starts drawing at the upper left. Caption in a limited area of sixty square miles. from 9.6 s.

Option a, 10.0 s to 10.8 s. The black boundary line traces from the upper left across the top of the loop and partway down the right, still open. The February page slides to the lower left of the map and stops. Three small car pins sit near the center. No sixty square miles tag visible on the map yet. Caption in a limited area of sixty square miles.

Option a, 11.0 s to 11.8 s. The black outline keeps tracing clockwise down the right side and across the bottom, wrapping around the three car pins; by 11.8 s it reaches the left side, nearly closed. A pinned paper tag 60 square miles, Limited area appears at the top of the map at 11.8 s. February page stays at lower left.

Option a, 12.0 s to 12.8 s. The limited area is now a closed black polygon with a translucent gray fill around the three car pins, under the tag 60 square miles, Limited area. The pins move slightly within the area. February page held at lower left. Caption clears at 12.8 s.

Option a, 13.0 s to 13.8 s. Map held at 13.0 s, then a cut to a wide brown-water scene: a small white SUV sits low in the water mid-frame with its reflection, stepped pale limestone ledges at right, live oaks and a small skyline beyond, faint rain streaks. Car occupies a small part of the frame and barely moves across the frames. Disclosure becomes A different car, April 20th account.

Option a, 14.0 s to 14.8 s. Same wide creek view: the small white car sits low in brown water at the same place in every frame while thin rain streaks shift. Caption band lies just under the car. No sweeping or downstream motion of the car visible yet. The cabin interior is not readable at this size.

Option a, 15.0 s to 15.8 s. Wide creek holds to 15.2 s, then a cut at 15.4 s to a closer side view: the white SUV sits in brown water up to its windows with empty seats visible through the glass. Between 15.4 and 15.8 s it drifts leftward with a small wake at its right end, the far bank and one live oak behind. Caption remains just under the car.

Option a, 16.0 s to 16.8 s. Closer creek shot: the empty white SUV sits in the brown current with a wake trailing right. Over these frames it tilts and lifts slightly, its front-right wheel rising out of the water by 16.8 s. Lateral travel within this second is small. Empty seats visible through the side windows. Caption stays below the car.

Option a, 17.0 s to 17.8 s. The creek car stays tilted in the current with its front wheel lifted and a wake; it does not visibly travel downstream far before the cut. At 17.6 s cut to a street: a white SUV on dark asphalt in front of a single-story house with a live oak and green street signs; brown water covers only the left part of the road; a wide pale sidewalk fills the bottom third. No caption at 17.6 to 17.8 s.

Option a, 18.0 s to 18.8 s. Brown floodwater spreads across the residential street from left to right while the white SUV sits mid-road; by 18.8 s water covers most of the asphalt and reaches about half the wheel height. House, live oak and green street signs behind. Caption sits just below the car, overlapping the lower edge of the water.

Option a, 19.0 s to 19.8 s. The white SUV sits stopped mid-street with brown floodwater to its wheel arches across the full road. At 19.6 and 19.8 s small amber hazard glows appear at its front and rear corners. The car is small in frame. Caption sits right under the car.

Option a, 20.0 s to 20.8 s. Closer side view: the white SUV stands stopped in brown water up to its wheel arches, empty seats visible through the windows, background house and live oak softened. Amber hazard lamps at front and rear glow at 20.2 to 20.4 s, go dark at 20.6 s, and glow again at 20.8 s. The car does not move. Caption is below the water line over the curb.

Option a, 21.0 s to 21.8 s. Same closer view of the stopped empty SUV in brown water. The hazard lamps at both ends keep blinking across frames. The background shifts slightly sideways. Caption unchanged below the water.

Option a, 22.0 s to 22.8 s. Last stranded-car frame at 22.0 s, then a cut to an olive wall over a brown desk with a tilted paper card headed Federal recall record, subline vehicle safety recall, ruled rows still blank, and a pen at its lower right. The card slides in from the right edge, initially cropped. Caption Waymo filed a software recall from 22.4 s.

Option a, 23.0 s to 23.8 s. The recall card slides to center and straightens on the desk. Its rows type in with a moving cursor: Recall type Software, Potential units affected 3,791 (small label text overlaps the value), then a Summary paragraph quoting the software may allow the vehicle to slow and then drive into standing water on higher speed roadways. Field labels are tiny at phone size. Caption Waymo filed a software recall.

Option a, 24.0 s to 24.8 s. The card finishes typing all rows, including Remedy The remedy is currently under development, Interim remedy weather constraints and maps, and Interim update All affected vehicles by April 20th, 2026. At 24.6 s the view widens: the card sits small at top and a grid of dashed empty car slots fills the desk below; at 24.8 s five white car icons fill the first row. Caption changes to that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars.

Option a, 25.0 s to 25.8 s. Under the small recall card, the grid of white car icons fills row by row, reaching nearly eight full rows by 25.8 s. A wooden rubber stamp descends from the top right corner from 25.6 s. No counter number visible on screen in this interval besides the card's small 3,791 row. Caption that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars.

Option a, 26.0 s to 26.8 s. A forearm in a blue sleeve presses a wooden stamp onto the card; when it lifts at 26.6 to 26.8 s an amber Software recall mark remains on the card. A paper tag swings in at upper left reading Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected in the record, and settles at 26.8 s. The car-icon grid is full below. Caption unchanged.

Option a, 27.0 s to 27.8 s. The stamp leaves the frame by 27.2 s; then the completed result holds: counter tag Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected in the record, beside the recall card stamped Software recall, over the full grid of white car icons. Caption unchanged.

Option a, 28.0 s to 28.8 s. The recall desk holds through 28.2 s, then a cut to a wide road with a dashed lane marking, a street lamp, trees and a small skyline under the label The recall wording, not a recorded event. A white SUV drives in from the left edge with speed streaks. At 28.8 s a faint translucent card with the recall sentence fades in above the road. No standing water visible on the lane yet. Caption The recall says the software may let a car slow, over the lower road edge.

Option a, 29.0 s to 29.8 s. Tracking shot: the white SUV holds near left-center with speed streaks while the lane dashes and trees slide past. The recall sentence card stays legible at top: The software may allow the vehicle to slow and then drive into standing water on higher speed roadways. No water on the lane in these frames. Caption The recall says the software may let a car slow, covers the lane edge just below the car.

Option a, 30.0 s to 30.8 s. The white SUV keeps tracking on the lane; from 30.6 s its rear brake lamp glows red. At 30.8 s the edge of a pale standing-water patch enters at the right of the lane ahead of the car. Quote card unchanged above. Caption unchanged.

Option a, 31.0 s to 31.8 s. The white SUV, brake lamp lit, creeps right toward a pale gray standing-water pool that sits at the right frame edge on the lane. The pool is partly cropped by the right edge and its lower half is overlapped by the caption band. The car has not reached the water by 31.8 s.

Option a, 32.0 s to 32.8 s. The SUV continues toward the pale water pool at the right edge; by 32.6 s it is still short of the pool and the caption has cleared. At 32.8 s a cut to a close side view: the large white SUV on dark asphalt with a thin wavy white line along the road under its wheels, and the recall sentence card above. A body of standing water is not clearly visible in the close frame. No word in the card is highlighted yet.

Option a, 33.0 s to 33.8 s. Close side view of the white SUV on dark asphalt, its wheels over a thin wavy white line. A pale gray water pool edge appears at the right frame edge ahead of the car and grows slightly; the front wheel has not entered it by 33.8 s. The recall sentence card stays above with no word lit. Caption then drive into standing water on higher speed roads. sits right under the wheels.

Option a, 34.0 s to 34.8 s. The white SUV's front wheel meets a pale gray standing-water sheet at 34.0 s; by 34.8 s the water spreads under the whole car to the rear wheel, with small spray and ripple lines at the wheels. At 34.2 s the word may lights in amber on the recall sentence card above. Water is pale gray rather than brown, and its lower part sits behind the caption band.

Option a, 35.0 s to 35.8 s. The white SUV rolls through the pale gray standing water: wake streaks and reflections fan behind it and small splashes show at the wheels, while the lamp pole in the background shifts left. The recall card holds with may lit amber. Water lower edge is under the caption band.

Option a, 36.0 s to 36.8 s. The SUV keeps rolling through the pale standing water with wake streaks and a splash at its front wheel; the background lamp pole slides out left. With the caption gone at 36.6 s, the water sheet's lower edge is fully visible under the car. The card still has may lit amber.

Option a, 37.0 s to 37.8 s. Cut back to the desk: the full recall card is larger now, with the amber Software recall stamp across its upper rows partly obscuring the 3,791 value. At 37.4 s the Remedy row, The remedy is currently under development, lights with a pale amber band and a dark left marker. Caption The federal record says the remedy is currently under development. No pen tip visible on the row yet.

Option a, 38.0 s to 38.8 s. The Remedy row stays highlighted. From 38.2 s a tan pen slides in from the right edge; by 38.6 to 38.8 s its tip rests at the card's right side level with the Interim remedy row, just under the highlighted Remedy row rather than on it. No hand visible, only the pen shaft. Caption unchanged.

Option a, 39.0 s to 39.8 s. The pen's tip sits off the card at right at 39.0 s; at 39.2 s a closer view, and a blue-sleeved arm brings a wooden stamp down first over the existing Software recall mark, then by 39.6 to 39.8 s down over the Summary row, hiding summary words. The stamp has not reached the highlighted Remedy row in this interval. Pen gone. Caption unchanged.

Option a, 40.0 s to 40.8 s. The blue-sleeved arm brings the wooden stamp down onto the Remedy row at 40.2 s; on lifting at 40.4 s an amber Under development mark sits over the row, partly covering the printed words The remedy is currently under development. The arm lifts back up through 40.8 s, passing over the Software recall mark. Caption unchanged.

Option a, 41.0 s to 41.8 s. The stamped record holds with both amber marks while the stamp exits. At 41.6 s a cut to a parking lot: four small white SUVs in a row in angled stalls, with an April calendar page and a small Vehicle maps card hanging from a wire strung between two posts at left. No weather tag visible yet. Cars are small in the frame. Caption As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits, from 41.8 s.

Option a, 42.0 s to 42.8 s. The parking lot frame holds almost unchanged: four small white SUVs in stalls, the April page and Vehicle maps card on the wire, caption As an interim step, Waymo tightened its weather limits. Only at 42.8 s does a small pale tag edge begin to appear at the top of the left post. The caption band sits directly under the row of cars.

Option a, 43.0 s to 43.8 s. A paper tag with a cloud-and-rain icon reading Weather limits, tightened slides in from the left along the wire and settles pinned at center by 43.4 s, beside the April page, above the four small white cars. Cars do not change. Caption unchanged.

Option a, 44.0 s to 44.8 s. The parking lot composition holds without visible change: Weather limits tightened tag pinned on the wire beside the April page and Vehicle maps card, four small white SUVs below, caption unchanged. Combined with 42.0 to 42.8 s, most of 41.6 to 44.8 s shows little change besides the tag entering at 43.0 to 43.4 s.

Option a, 45.0 s to 45.8 s. Static parking lot through 45.2 s; caption clears at 45.4 s; at 45.6 s the framing pushes in slightly so the cars and cards enlarge. The April page has not flipped to a date yet. Caption and every affected car had the update by April twentieth. from 45.8 s.

Option a, 46.0 s to 46.8 s. The calendar page flips: a sheet lifts upward off the top while a large 20 shows under April; by 46.8 s it reads April 20 cleanly. Weather limits tag and Vehicle maps card remain. The four white SUVs carry no check marks yet. Caption and every affected car had the update by April twentieth.

Option a, 47.0 s to 47.8 s. The lot holds static with April 20, the weather tag and the Vehicle maps card above four white SUVs. At 47.8 s a small round check badge appears just above the leftmost car. Badge is small relative to frame. Caption unchanged.

Option a, 48.0 s to 48.8 s. White round check badges pop in above the four SUVs left to right, all four checked by 48.8 s. The Vehicle maps card gains its own check and a tiny updated label at 48.6 to 48.8 s. April 20 and the weather tag remain above. Badges and cars are small in the frame; caption sits right below the cars.

Option a, 49.0 s to 49.8 s. The completed interim-update state holds: four white SUVs each with a check badge, Vehicle maps card checked and marked updated, April 20 page, Weather limits tightened tag. Caption clears at 49.8 s.

Option a, 50.0 s to 50.8 s. Cut back to the airport curb from the opening: the white SUV sits parked over the painted bay beside the bench and suitcase, the phone card top left reads Arriving, At the curb, and the label reads A generic airport ride, not the flood cars. No door movement visible yet. Caption So the airport ride is open, from 50.2 s.

Option a, 51.0 s to 51.8 s. At the curb, the white SUV's rear side door swings open from 51.2 s, showing a dark cabin with a pale seat, and remains open through 51.8 s. The car is small, in the right half of the frame. Phone card still reads Arriving. Caption So the airport ride is open, under the car.

Option a, 52.0 s to 52.8 s. The curb shot with the open rear door holds until 52.6 s. At 52.8 s a cut to a wider view: the SUV with its open door sits small at the curb near the bench and suitcase, a small phone stands on the curb, and a small recall card reading The remedy is currently under development with an amber stamp lies on the road in the lower middle. The card text is tiny at phone size.

Option a, 53.0 s to 53.8 s. Wide curb view holds: the white SUV with its rear door open at the bay, a small phone on the curb, and a small recall card lying on the asphalt below reading The remedy is currently under development with a tiny amber stamp. The card sits just above the caption band. Scene shifts slightly sideways. Caption and the federal record lists the flood remedy.

Option a, 54.0 s to 54.8 s. The foreground recall card slides toward the left and grows, straightening until it reads clearly Federal recall record, The remedy is currently under development, with an amber Under development stamp at its lower right. Its bottom edge meets the top of the caption band. The SUV with its door open stays at the curb above. Caption unchanged.

Option a, 55.0 s to 55.8 s. Static hold: the white SUV with its rear door open at the curb above, the recall card below reading The remedy is currently under development with an amber Under development stamp. Card's lower edge touches the caption band. No new motion in this interval.

Option a, 56.0 s to 56.8 s. After the wide hold, at 56.4 s the frame splits: the open-door white SUV at the airport curb fills the top half, and below on a wooden desk band sit the recall card reading The remedy is currently under development with its amber stamp beside a phone showing a route and Arriving. Caption as currently under development. from 56.6 s.

Option a, 57.0 s to 57.8 s. The split ending holds: open-door SUV at the curb above, recall card and phone on the desk below. A dark underline draws beneath under development on the card between 57.2 and 57.6 s. Caption as currently under development.

Option a, 58.0 s to 58.8 s. The split ending (open-door SUV at curb above, stamped recall card and Arriving phone below) holds without caption from 58.2 s, then at 58.6 s cuts to a dark credits card with a Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com, and source, illustration, map and music credits.
Option a, 59.0 s to 59.8 s. Static dark credits card with the Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, texasaidocket.com and the source, illustration, map and music credits. No motion.
Option a, 60.0 s to 60.8 s. The same dark credits card holds unchanged in all five frames: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com, sources, illustration, map and music credit lines.
Option a, 61.0 s to 61.8 s. Credits card unchanged across all five frames: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com and the credit lines on a dark background.
Option a, 62.0 s to 62.8 s. Credits card holds unchanged in all five frames: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com and credit lines.
Option a, 63.0 s to 63.433 s, final four samples including last frame 1903. The credits card holds unchanged to the end: Lone Star flag, Texas AI Docket, texasaidocket.com and credit lines.

Option b, 0.0 s to 0.8 s. Straight-down view of a two-lane road beside a pale sidewalk: a white car with a round roof dome and red tail lamps drives upward toward an outlined pickup bay. Phone card top left reads Ride requested, Finding a car. A bench with a small phone and a teal bin sit on the sidewalk. Caption from 0.2 s overlaps the car at 0.2 to 0.6 s. No airport sign visible in this view.

Option b, 1.0 s to 1.8 s. From above, the white car drives into the outlined bay by 1.2 s and stays inside it with red tail lamps through 1.8 s, shifting slightly in position. Phone card unchanged. Caption below the car.

Option b, 2.0 s to 2.8 s. Overhead car holds in the bay while a Texas-outline locator card appears top right at 2.2 s. At 2.6 s a cut inside the cab: steering wheel at left, dashboard map screen, two empty seats, an airplane pickup sign beyond the windshield. Caption overlaps the seat tops. Phone card unchanged.

Option b, 3.0 s to 3.8 s. Interior cab: the steering wheel's tan marker turns from the top toward the right with no hands and empty seats; the airplane sign slides right out of the windshield. The Texas outline completes on the locator card. Caption covers the seat tops.

Option b, 4.0 s to 4.8 s. The cab interior holds still in all five frames: wheel marker parked at right, empty seats, mostly blank windshield with the sign edge at right, Texas locator complete. No visible change.

Option b, 5.0 s to 5.8 s. Interior holds until 5.2 s, then a cut at 5.4 s to a ground-level curb view nearly matching option a: a large tilted phone reading Ride requested in front of a white SUV parked at the bay under an airport canopy with an airplane pickup sign. Locator card gains a ring in south-central Texas. Caption the airport included.

Option b, 6.0 s to 6.8 s. The phone's car marker reaches the destination pin and the status changes from Ride requested to Arriving, At the curb at 6.2 s; the real car stays parked at the bay behind. Caption clears at 6.6 s. Same composition and timing as option a in this interval.

Option b, 7.0 s to 7.8 s. Cut to a flat square paper map seen from directly above on an olive background, with a February page at its lower left and three small car pins near center. It holds with little change until 7.8 s, when a blue river segment and orange road strokes start drawing. Caption The service began in February from 7.2 s.

Option b, 8.0 s to 8.8 s. From straight above, the river and orange highways draw across the paper map and the orange loop ring closes around the three central pins by 8.6 s. The February page stays at lower left. Locator card fades at 8.0 s. Caption The service began in February.

Option b, 9.0 s to 9.8 s. Overhead map holds to 9.2 s, then at 9.4 s a cut to the map on a wooden table in perspective with sky behind. The February page lies tilted on the map and slides toward the center by 9.8 s, covering the central pins, while a short black outline line begins at upper left. Caption in a limited area of sixty square miles. from 9.6 s.

Option b, 10.0 s to 10.8 s. On the angled table map, the black boundary traces across the top of the loop and partway down the right side, still open. The February page slides to the lower left corner. Three car pins near center. Matches option a's s2 close shot in this interval.

Option b, 11.0 s to 11.8 s. The black outline continues clockwise down the right and across the bottom around the three pins, nearly closed by 11.8 s, when a pinned tag 60 square miles, Limited area appears at the top. February page at lower left. Same as option a in this interval.

Option b, 12.0 s to 12.8 s. The closed, gray-filled limited area holds around the three pins under the tag 60 square miles, Limited area, with the February page at lower left. Pins drift slightly. Caption clears at 12.8 s. Same as option a.

Option b, 13.0 s to 13.8 s. Cut at 13.2 s from the map to a straight-down creek view: a brown water channel runs horizontally between pale wavy limestone banks, round green tree canopies above and below, and a small white car roof with a dome sits mid-channel with faint wake lines. The car barely moves across these frames. No visible rain. Caption from 13.4 s.

Option b, 14.0 s to 14.8 s. Same overhead creek: the white car roof sits mid-channel and drifts only slightly right across the frames. No visible rain rings or cabin interior from this angle. Caption over the lower bank. Little change through this second.

Option b, 15.0 s to 15.8 s. Overhead creek holds to 15.2 s, then at 15.4 s a cut to the same ground-level side view used by option a: the white SUV deep in brown water with empty seats visible through the windows, a live oak on the far bank, rain streaks, and a small wake at its right as it drifts left.

Option b, 16.0 s to 16.8 s. The empty white SUV in the brown current tilts so its front-right wheel lifts out of the water by 16.8 s, with a wake trailing right; lateral travel is small. Same shot and motion as option a in this interval.

Option b, 17.0 s to 17.8 s. The tilted creek SUV holds to 17.4 s. At 17.6 s cut to a straight-down residential block: four square roofs drawn as gray and black triangles, two round trees, a horizontal dark street with a white car roof at left and brown water covering the street's left third around the car. Roofs read as flat geometric squares at this size.

Option b, 18.0 s to 18.8 s. From above, brown floodwater spreads left to right along the street until it covers the full width by 18.8 s, with the white car roof sitting in it at left-center. The caption band sits over the lower pair of roofs. Roofs remain flat black-and-gray triangle squares.

Option b, 19.0 s to 19.8 s. From above, the white car roof stops mid-street in brown floodwater that covers the whole road. From 19.6 s faint amber glows appear at its corners, small at this size. Caption over the lower roofs.

Option b, 20.0 s to 20.8 s. Cut to a ground-level side view: the empty white SUV stands in brown floodwater to its wheel arches in front of a row of single-story houses, a live oak and green street signs. Amber hazard lamps at both ends blink on at 20.2 to 20.4 s, dim at 20.6 s, and glow again at 20.8 s. A wide pale sidewalk fills the lower half with the caption on it.

Option b, 21.0 s to 21.8 s. The stopped empty SUV in floodwater keeps blinking its amber hazard lamps in front of the houses and live oak. The frame drifts slightly up and down. Same composition as option a's stranded-car close in this interval.

Option b, 22.0 s to 22.8 s. After the stranded car at 22.0 s, a cut at 22.2 s to a flat overhead brown desk panel on an olive background: a tilted Federal recall record card with blank ruled rows slides in from the upper right, partly cropped, with a pen at lower right. Caption Waymo filed a software recall from 22.4 s.

Option b, 23.0 s to 23.8 s. On the overhead desk the recall card straightens to center and types in Recall type Software, Potential units affected 3,791 (label overlaps value), and the Summary sentence about slowing then driving into standing water on higher speed roadways. Field labels are tiny. Same card behavior as option a with a flat background.

Option b, 24.0 s to 24.8 s. The card finishes typing its Remedy, Interim remedy and Interim update rows; at 24.6 s the view widens to the card small at top over an empty grid of dashed car slots, and at 24.8 s five white car icons fill the first row. Caption that could affect nearly thirty eight hundred cars. Same beat as option a.

Option b, 25.0 s to 25.8 s. The car-icon grid fills row by row under the small recall card, nearly eight rows by 25.8 s, while a wooden stamp descends from the top right. This page's image hash is the same as option a's sequence-025 page, so these five sampled frames are identical between the two films.

Option b, 26.0 s to 26.8 s. A blue-sleeved arm stamps the card; the Nearly 3,800 vehicles, 3,791 potentially affected tag swings in and settles, and an amber Software recall mark remains as the stamp lifts. Page image hash equals option a's sequence-026 page; frames identical between films here.

Option b, 27.0 s to 27.8 s. The stamp exits and the result holds: Nearly 3,800 vehicles tag, stamped Software recall card and full icon grid. Page image hash equals option a's sequence-027; identical frames.

Option b, 28.0 s to 28.8 s. Desk holds to 28.2 s, then at 28.4 s a cut to a straight-down two-lane road with green verges; a small white car roof drives up the right lane. At 28.6 and 28.8 s the car sits at or just above the caption band, partly covered at 28.6 s. A translucent recall-sentence card fades in near the top at 28.8 s. No water visible.

Option b, 29.0 s to 29.8 s. From above, the white car roof holds in the right lane just above the caption band while lane dashes scroll past. The recall sentence card sits near the top, readable. From 29.2 s a pale gray standing-water patch enters at the top edge ahead of the car and grows. Gap between car and water is still large at 29.8 s.

Option b, 30.0 s to 30.8 s. From above, a pale gray standing-water patch fills the right lane ahead and extends downward toward the car, partly behind the recall card. The car holds just above the caption band; at 30.8 s small red brake dots show at its rear. Brake lamps are tiny at this framing.

Option b, 31.0 s to 31.8 s. From above, the car with tiny red rear lamps edges up toward the pale water patch, whose upper half sits behind the recall card. The car has not reached the water by 31.8 s. Caption directly under the car.

Option b, 32.0 s to 32.8 s. From above, the car stays just short of the pale water patch through 32.6 s. At 32.8 s a cut to a close side view of the white SUV on dark asphalt with a thin wavy white line under its wheels, the recall sentence card above, green verge below. This close view matches option a's close shot.
